description: Verify the account's phone number with the code the user received from `send_phone_verification_code`. On success, retry what failed with VERIFICATION_REQUIRED; `emailVerified: false` in the response means the email still needs verifying: `send_email_verification_code`, then `confirm_email_verification` with the code the user reads out (or they click the link in that email). PHONE_CODE_INVALID means a wrong or expired code: check it with the user, or send a new one.

code.description: The code the user received, exactly as texted (case does not matter).

name: confirm_phone_verification
title: Confirm Phone Verification
